description: Hardens channel worker startup cleanup and preserves explicitly managed Claude statusline assets.
changelog:
**Bug fixes:**
- Worker startup now stops the runtime if channel registration or task projection fails, preventing an orphaned worker.
- `trellis update` preserves a Claude statusline script only when the existing Claude settings explicitly reference the managed script; `trellis uninstall` removes it consistently.
- Bundled `trellis-meta` guidance now documents which generated Trellis assets should be tracked by Git.
notes: No migration required. Existing projects can upgrade normally.
